headword: {新陳代謝|しんちんたいしゃ}

definitions.explanation: The process by which the body converts food into energy and replaces old cells with new ones. Also used figuratively for the renewal or turnover of people or ideas in an organization.

examples.japanese: {運動|うんどう}すると{新陳代謝|しんちんたいしゃ}が{上|あ}がる。
{年齢|ねんれい}とともに{新陳代謝|しんちんたいしゃ}が{落|お}ちてくる。
{新陳代謝|しんちんたいしゃ}を{良|よ}くするために、{毎朝|まいあさ}{水|みず}を{飲|の}むようにしている。
examples.english: I make a point of drinking water every morning to improve my metabolism.

notes:
USAGE:
{新陳代謝|しんちんたいしゃ} literally means "new replaces old" ({新|しん}{陳|ちん} = new and old, {代謝|たいしゃ} = replacement/exchange). It is most commonly used in health and fitness contexts but can also describe organizational renewal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新陳代謝|しんちんたいしゃ}が{良|よ}い (have a good metabolism)
- {新陳代謝|しんちんたいしゃ}を{上|あ}げる (boost metabolism)
- {新陳代謝|しんちんたいしゃ}が{落|お}ちる (metabolism drops)

SHORTENED FORM:
In medical or scientific contexts, {代謝|たいしゃ} alone is often used (e.g., {基礎代謝|きそたいしゃ} = basal metabolism).
